capability_rows.selection_rule: max validation-split first-try pass rate; ties -> lower mean verified seconds
capability_rows.trusted_scope: development-only synthetic smoke; not a production scope

field_notes.attempt_denominator: All twenty first-try records per lap, including not_run and local harness errors. Lap1 is incomplete as model-quality measurement.
field_notes.actual_requests: Lap1 has six transmitted request bodies and five completed responses; fourteen later requests blocked locally. Later laps submitted all twenty.
field_notes.timing_and_tokens: Canonical model+oracle statistics exclude missing inference timings; recorded token totals omit unavailable usage from aborted requests. End-to-end controller time is a separate metric.
field_notes.candidate_execution: A non-null builder exit means builder ran; syntax/compile failures do not prove solve executed. Fresh verifier exit can be null when not reached.
field_notes.isolation: Shared preflight probe flag does not mean every candidate was executed. Original legacy container wording is retained with a run-specific caveat.
field_notes.capability_selection: best_lap_id remains null because no validation split exists; highest development score is descriptive only.
field_notes.no_severe_regression: Zero observed severe flags does not imply domain success; major deformation failures are retained.
field_notes.repeatability: No identical-repeat pair or cross-hardware reproducibility test was run for Granite. Nonzero-temperature variants remain single runs.
field_notes.tokens_not_gb: num_ctx and num_predict are token limits, not VRAM allocations.
